title: רב נתן בר אמי

paragraphs: Rav Natan bar Ammi: Rava compelled him to give four hundred zuz in charity, Bava Batra 8b; Ketubbot 49b. He interpreted before Rava, Shabbat 150b. Rava told him to heed Abaye's view, Bava Batra 135a. News of his mother’s death reached him from Bei Ḥozai; he came before Rava, Mo'ed Katan 20a. He spoke to Ravina, Sanhedrin 30a.
